prompt: Name one of the seven dwarfs in Snow White.

answers.name: Grumpy
answers.fact: The holdout who objects to Snow White staying, and the last to come round.

answers.name: Dopey
answers.fact: The only one who never speaks - the others say he simply never tried.

answers.name: Sleepy
answers.fact: Drowsy throughout, and the one most often confused with Dopey.

answers.name: Happy
answers.fact: The stout, cheerful one, and the dwarf who introduces the others.

answers.name: Sneezy
answers.fact: His sneezes are strong enough to blow the others across the room.

answers.name: Doc
answers.fact: The leader, who muddles his words whenever he gets flustered.

answers.name: Bashful
answers.fact: The shy one, and the single most forgotten name of the seven.

distractors.name: Snow White
distractors.note: The heroine, but not one of the dwarfs.

distractors.name: The Huntsman
distractors.note: Sent to kill Snow White, and not a dwarf.

distractors.name: Prince Charming
distractors.note: Not a dwarf, and in this story barely a character.

distractors.name: Thorin
distractors.note: From The Hobbit - a different set of dwarves entirely.

distractors.name: Balin
distractors.note: One of Tolkien's thirteen, not one of these seven.

distractors.name: Gimli
distractors.note: Tolkien again, and a generation later at that.

distractors.name: Sleazy
distractors.note: Not one of them, though people guess it surprisingly often.

distractors.name: Stubby
distractors.note: One of about fifty names Disney considered and dropped.
